theorem QOU.IwahoriHecke.MarkovPeel.qTrace_peel_physical {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (q qi : R) {m : ℕ} (hqi : q * qi = 1) (w : Fin 2 → R) (h0 : w 0 = 1) (h1 : w 1 = q ^ 2) (x : Balanced.BalancedHecke (TensorEmbed.coxA m) q) :
QuantumTrace.qTrace q qi hqi w ((tower q qi hqi) x * Balanced.sigma (TensorEmbed.coxA (m + 1)) q qi (Fin.last m)) = q ^ 3 * QuantumTrace.qTrace q qi hqi w x

theorem QOU.IwahoriHecke.MarkovPeel.qTrace_peel {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (q qi : R) {m : ℕ} (hqi : q * qi = 1) (w : Fin 2 → R) (z : R) (hP : ∀ (u : Fin 2), ∑ t : Fin 2, w t * RMatrix.rCheck q qi (u, t) (u, t) = z) (x : Balanced.BalancedHecke (TensorEmbed.coxA m) q) :
QuantumTrace.qTrace q qi hqi w ((tower q qi hqi) x * Balanced.sigma (TensorEmbed.coxA (m + 1)) q qi (Fin.last m)) = z * QuantumTrace.qTrace q qi hqi w x

theorem QOU.IwahoriHecke.MarkovPeel.trace_peel {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (q qi : R) {m : ℕ} (w : Fin 2 → R) (z : R) (hP : ∀ (u : Fin 2), ∑ t : Fin 2, w t * RMatrix.rCheck q qi (u, t) (u, t) = z) (X : Matrix (Fin (m + 1) → Fin 2) (Fin (m + 1) → Fin 2) R) :
(QuantumTrace.siteWeight w * (extendSiteHom X * TensorEmbed.strandBraid q qi (Fin.last m))).trace = z * (QuantumTrace.siteWeight w * X).trace

theorem QOU.IwahoriHecke.MarkovPeel.trace_siteWeight_mul {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (w : Fin 2 → R) (M : Matrix (Fin n → Fin 2) (Fin n → Fin 2) R) :
(QuantumTrace.siteWeight w * M).trace = ∑ a : Fin n → Fin 2, (∏ k : Fin n, w (a k)) * M a a

theorem QOU.IwahoriHecke.MarkovPeel.extendSite_mul_lastBraid_diag {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (q qi : R) {m : ℕ} (X : Matrix (Fin (m + 1) → Fin 2) (Fin (m + 1) → Fin 2) R) (u : Fin (m + 2) → Fin 2) :
(extendSiteHom X * TensorEmbed.strandBraid q qi (Fin.last m)) u u = (X (fun (k : Fin (m + 1)) => u k.castSucc) fun (k : Fin (m + 1)) => u k.castSucc) * RMatrix.rCheck q qi (u (Fin.last m).castSucc, u (Fin.last (m + 1))) (u (Fin.last m).castSucc, u (Fin.last (m + 1)))

theorem QOU.IwahoriHecke.MarkovPeel.peel_scalar_of_physical {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (q qi : R) (hqi : q * qi = 1) (w : Fin 2 → R) (h0 : w 0 = 1) (h1 : w 1 = q ^ 2) (u : Fin 2) :
∑ t : Fin 2, w t * RMatrix.rCheck q qi (u, t) (u, t) = q ^ 3

theorem QOU.IwahoriHecke.MarkovPeel.peel_weight_eq {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (q qi : R) (hqi : q * qi = 1) (w : Fin 2 → R) (z : R) (hP : ∀ (u : Fin 2), ∑ t : Fin 2, w t * RMatrix.rCheck q qi (u, t) (u, t) = z) (h0 : w 0 = 1) :
w 1 = q ^ 2 ∧ z = q ^ 3

theorem QOU.IwahoriHecke.MarkovPeel.peel_forces_physical_weight {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (q qi : R) (w : Fin 2 → R) (z : R) (hP : ∀ (u : Fin 2), ∑ t : Fin 2, w t * RMatrix.rCheck q qi (u, t) (u, t) = z) :
w 0 * q = w 1 * qi ∧ z = w 1 * q

theorem QOU.IwahoriHecke.MarkovPeel.rCheck_diag_apply {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (q qi : R) (u t : Fin 2) :
RMatrix.rCheck q qi (u, t) (u, t) = if u = t then q else if u < t then q - qi else 0

theorem QOU.IwahoriHecke.MarkovPeel.heckeActionN_tower {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (q qi : R) {m : ℕ} (hqi : q * qi = 1) (x : Balanced.BalancedHecke (TensorEmbed.coxA m) q) :
(TensorEmbed.heckeActionN q qi hqi) ((tower q qi hqi) x) = extendSiteHom ((TensorEmbed.heckeActionN q qi hqi) x)

theorem QOU.IwahoriHecke.MarkovPeel.extendSite_strandBraid {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (q qi : R) {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m) :
extendSiteHom (TensorEmbed.strandBraid q qi a) = TensorEmbed.strandBraid q qi a.castSucc

theorem QOU.IwahoriHecke.MarkovPeel.tower_sigma {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (q qi : R) {m : ℕ} (hqi : q * qi = 1) (a : Fin m) :
(tower q qi hqi) (Balanced.sigma (TensorEmbed.coxA m) q qi a) = Balanced.sigma (TensorEmbed.coxA (m + 1)) q qi a.castSucc

noncomputable def QOU.IwahoriHecke.MarkovPeel.tower {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (q qi : R) {m : ℕ} (hqi : q * qi = 1) :
Balanced.BalancedHecke (TensorEmbed.coxA m) q →ₐ[R] Balanced.BalancedHecke (TensorEmbed.coxA (m + 1)) q

theorem QOU.IwahoriHecke.MarkovPeel.coxA_castSucc {m : ℕ} (a b : Fin m) :
TensorEmbed.coxA (m + 1) a.castSucc b.castSucc = TensorEmbed.coxA m a b

theorem QOU.IwahoriHecke.MarkovPeel.extendSiteHom_apply {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {m : ℕ} (X : Matrix (Fin (m + 1) → Fin 2) (Fin (m + 1) → Fin 2) R) (a b : Fin (m + 2) → Fin 2) :
extendSiteHom X a b = (if a (Fin.last (m + 1)) = b (Fin.last (m + 1)) then 1 else 0) * X (fun (k : Fin (m + 1)) => a k.castSucc) fun (k : Fin (m + 1)) => b k.castSucc

noncomputable def QOU.IwahoriHecke.MarkovPeel.extendSiteHom {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {m : ℕ} :
Matrix (Fin (m + 1) → Fin 2) (Fin (m + 1) → Fin 2) R →ₐ[R] Matrix (Fin (m + 2) → Fin 2) (Fin (m + 2) → Fin 2) R

def QOU.IwahoriHecke.MarkovPeel.lastSplit (m : ℕ) :
Fin 2 × (Fin (m + 1) → Fin 2) ≃ (Fin (m + 2) → Fin 2)
